reference_summary: Meridian Suite product meeting of June 12, 2025. Version 4.2 is deployed at 78% of customers with strong adoption of real-time reporting (61%), but two regressions (slow exports beyond 50,000 rows, loss of the default filter) will be fixed in 4.2.3 at the end of June. Three workstreams are prioritized for Q3: a rebuild of the internal search, a SAML SSO connector and a performance audit of the API; the mobile application is postponed to Q4. The June 5 incident (47 minutes of downtime in the EU region) was caused by a migration without a rate limit and an alert threshold set too high; mandatory rate limits, a review of thresholds and customer communication within 30 minutes are decided.

Helvetia Conseil's remote work policy v3.1 (effective September 1, 2025) allows up to three days of remote work per week on a voluntary basis, with two mandatory on-site days including Tuesday. Eligibility requires three months of seniority and compatible duties. The company provides a secure laptop and 30 euros per month; access to customer data goes exclusively through the VPN and any security incident must be reported within four hours. Mandatory availability windows are 9:30-12:00 and 14:00-17:00, with a right to disconnect, and remote work abroad is limited to ten days per year within the EU. Reviewed every two years with an annual report.

In 2025, the Lumen Foundation equipped 214 schools through "Connection for All" (38,000 students, +14 points in digital skills), launched "Passerelle" for adults retraining (1,340 enrolled versus 800 expected, 61% of pathways completed) and moved its headquarters (-22% in costs). Revenue reaches €6.4M (+31%) for a surplus of €500,000 allocated to reserves. Points to watch: insufficient staffing on Passerelle (1 trainer for 24 learners), dependence on the funder NumOuest (28% of revenue, capped at 25% from 2027) and data retention non-compliances to be fixed by March 2026. 2026 priorities: consolidate Passerelle, complete the postponed rollouts, diversify funding and finalize the internal restructuring.
